description.narrative: HCFC PHASE-OUT MANAGEMENT PLAN (STAGE I) (PREPARATION, REFRIGERATION SERVICING, TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE, LEGISLATION CUSTOMS TRAINING AND MONITORING) The preparation of the HCFC Phase-out Management Plan (HPMP) in Mexico has been implemented by UNIDO as lead and UNDP as cooperating implementing agency. On the assignment of the Government of Mexico UNDP was entrusted with the survey of HCFC consumption and planning of activities in the foam sector, whereas UNIDO assumed the responsibility of the same activities in the remaining sectors, mainly refrigeration and air conditioning manufacturing and service sectors; aerosol, solvent, firefighting sectors, as well as HCFC production sector. UNIDO was also responsible for the formulation of the national overarching HCFC phase out strategy and coordination of the work of the two implementing agencies. The HPMP of Mexico contains the Compliance Strategy and Action Plan for the reduction of consumption of substances controlled under Annex C Group I (HCFCs) of the Montreal Protocol, in order to meet the HCFC freeze obligation in 2013 and the HCFC 10% reduction obligation in 2015. It also includes an outline of the envisaged HCFC compliance strategy until 2040.
